description: The content of one attachment of a mail message (a patch, a log, a test case), chosen by 1-based index or a filename substring, as listed in get_message/get_thread attachments. Text attachments come back as decoded text (a .patch is ready to read or `git apply`), binary ones as base64 with encoding=base64; size is the decoded byte count. Cite the message as https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

filename.description: Substring to match against attachment filenames

inbox.description: Mailing list name, e.g. pgsql-general. Defaults to pgsql-hackers when omitted. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

message_id.description: Message-ID (with or without angle brackets), or a message URL (postgr.es/m/..., postgresql.org/message-id/..., pg.ddx.io/m/...)

name: get_attachment
